Camelot – Original Motion Picture Soundtrack – Warner Bros. Records BS 1712 – Stereo LP

Original soundtrack album from the classic 1967 motion picture Camelot, starring Richard Harris, Vanessa Redgrave, Franco Nero and David Hemmings.

Features music by Frederick Loewe and lyrics by Alan Jay Lerner, including:

  • I Wonder What the King Is Doing Tonight
  • The Simple Joys of Maidenhood
  • Camelot
  • C'est Moi
  • The Lusty Month of May
  • How to Handle a Woman
  • If Ever I Would Leave You
  • What Do the Simple Folk Do?
  • I Loved You Once in Silence
  • Finale Ultimo

Label: Warner Bros. Records
Catalog: BS 1712
Format: 12" Vinyl LP
Speed: 33⅓ RPM
Stereo
Genre: Soundtrack / Musical
